subject.title: GChat: Typing indicator persists after NO_REPLY + emoji reaction

question: Should maintainers adopt/review the open fork PR for this issue, close it and queue a replacement, or reject the Google Chat NO_REPLY cleanup direction?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the only open fix candidate is an external fork PR and ClawSweeper should not queue a competing fix until maintainers decide that path.

options.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
options.body: Review https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/155, request real Google Chat proof, and land or port it if the current-main diff is still the right fix.

options.title: Close the fork PR and queue a replacement
options.body: If the fork branch is not worth adopting, close it and let a narrow OpenClaw repair PR implement the same lifecycle cleanup with focused tests.

options.title: Reject the cleanup direction
options.body: Close the candidate and keep this issue only if maintainers decide stale reaction-only placeholders are acceptable or should be solved by a different channel lifecycle design.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/155, request real Google Chat proof, and land or port it if the current-main diff is still the right fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent Google Chat monitor and reply-delivery history makes this the best available routing owner for deciding whether to adopt or replace the candidate fix.
